entity: Groupon, Inc. — US employing entity (to confirm)
region: Illinois outside Chicago and Cook County
summary: The Illinois Paid Leave for All Workers Act: 1 hour per 40 worked, up to 40 hours a year, for any reason, usable after 90 days. Carry-over is required but may be capped at 40 hours, and there is no payout unless the leave sits in a vacation bank.

locationAssumption.citation: 820 ILCS 192/15(p): PLAWA covers Illinois employees whose work isn't covered by a local paid-leave ordinance in effect on 1 January 2024 (Chicago, Cook County)

rule.citation: Leave is taken in hours of the scheduled shift
rule.note: Federal and state law set no counting rule for company PTO.

source.citation: Groupon US company holiday calendar (no private-sector statutory holidays in Illinois)
source.note: Calendar is a placeholder (no public Groupon US holiday list exists); all dates match OPM federal holiday observance rules.

rule.citation: Company holidays are paid days off outside the leave banks (policy assumption)

820 ILCS 192/15(b) and 56 Ill. Adm. Code 200.220: at least 1 hour per 40 hours worked, up to 40 hours per 12-month period; exempt employees are deemed to work 40 hours a week; usable after 90 days (§15(g))
820 ILCS 192/15(b): accrual per hours worked (front-loading 40 hours is the alternative, §15(c))
rule.note: Accrual year assumed to be the calendar year.

rule.citation: 56 Ill. Adm. Code 200.320(a): unused leave carries over, but the employer may restrict carry-over above 40 hours
PLAWA leave is for any reason; it says nothing about illness during leave
rule.note: Company policy decides whether days come back.

rule.citation: 820 ILCS 192/15(j),(l) and 56 Ill. Adm. Code 200.460: no payout, unless the leave is credited to a vacation or PTO bank, which the Illinois Wage Payment and Collection Act then requires to be paid out

extras.label: Notice and increments
extras.citation: 820 ILCS 192/15(h): up to 7 calendar days' notice for foreseeable leave; §15(b), 56 Ill. Adm. Code 200.300(g): a minimum increment of no more than 2 hours a day
